limitations.play_now_gap: Saved conduct figures are interim proxy, not a validated forecast of session-ready demand. Readiness of locations/links/NPC situations/usable procedures is a product requirement and unknown current support; counts must be refined with actual scenario research.
limitations.eligibility: All45 calculable games ranked regardless of old D>1000 eligibility. Existing model1.2 cohort/threshold not rewritten. Per-scenario D>1000 flags are research candidates, not automatic membership.
